THE decisive item. Eq. (17)-(18) is literally the definition of an EXACT backward self-similar solution of 3D Navier-Stokes on R^3 (before the torus transfer). Combined with H12 (the profile is smooth, axis-regular, and Gevrey-decaying, hence certainly in L^3(R^3) and far stronger classes), this is exactly the object Necas-Ruzicka-Sverak (Acta Math. 176 (1996)) prove is trivial (U in L^3(R^3) nontrivial exact backward self-similar => U = 0), extended by Tsai (ARMA 143 (1998)) to weaker decay/local-energy hypotheses. The manuscript's own bibliography cites Jia-Sverak on FORWARD self-similar solutions (which DO exist) in the literature section, and never cites, engages, or attempts to evade Necas-Ruzicka-Sverak or Tsai anywhere in the 818-line source. A nontrivial certified stationary profile (leading coefficient +5.0, Son.tex l.664) forces the reconstructed u_bar to be a nontrivial member of exactly the excluded class.
